verdict.rationale: Zep is a memory and context-graph service that agents call. It is not an agent or tool-using runtime, so plugging in MCP servers so the product can use their tools is outside its role. The evidence documents only MCP server offerings (the Memory MCP Server and the Graphiti MCP server), which expose Zep to MCP clients. That is the opposite role and does not make the client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
